items.title: Zero-dimensional coherent sheaves are cohomologically trivial: a coherent sheaf on a locally Noetherian scheme whose support has dimension at most 0 is generated by global sections and has vanishing higher cohomology.
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter coherent.tex (Cohomology of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28), file coherent.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Each step is written in the span: factor F as i_*G for G coherent on the scheme-theoretic support Z (lemma-coherent-support-closed on the same shelf); a locally Noetherian scheme of dimension 0 is a disjoint union of affines (properties-lemma-locally-Noetherian-dimension-0), so G is globally generated with zero higher cohomology (affine vanishing); the pushforward of a globally generated sheaf by any morphism is globally generated; and cohomology agrees along i since a closed immersion is affine (lemma-relative-affine-cohomology), transporting the vanishing from G to F.
